scope: Read-only baseline audit of canonical 2024–2026 corpus only. No prior-2024 partial outputs read; no network calls.
notes: Document counts deduplicate by primary content SHA256. Google Drive wrapper HTML is retained as provenance but is not a second decision document.
Page count is independently read from each of 63 local PDF files; the single published HTML source has no pagination.
Record fingerprints use canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8, ensure_ascii=False) to test preservation if combined ledgers later gain records.
Hashes certify the current local baseline only; they do not establish archive/calendar completeness or independently validate extraction meaning.
